transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the pre-trade huddle. We need to finalize the collateral reinvestment plan for the $25 million in cash collateral from our securities-lending book. The draft proposal is to invest the full amount in 30-day commercial paper issued by Delta Financial. Before I authorize anything, I want to hear from each of you -- counterparty risk, compliance, client coverage, and investment operations. Please give me your one-minute exception reports so we can surface any issues before I make the final call.

transcript.text: I have a critical compliance exception to flag. I reviewed the applicable collateral-investment mandate this week, and it explicitly restricts cash collateral investments to government Treasury bills or AAA-rated bank certificates of deposit only, each with a maximum maturity of 14 days. The draft plan to invest in 30-day commercial paper issued by Delta Financial violates this mandate on two counts -- commercial paper is not a permitted instrument, and 30 days exceeds the 14-day maturity limit. I also want to flag that this restriction has not yet been added to the desk's pre-trade checklist, which is why it hasn't been caught through our normal process.
